card.title: Everything Is a Contest
card.instruction: Turn every difference or disagreement into a competition you intend to win.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I want potatoes; you want pizza. First to peel five chooses. I've done four.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll order pizza unless you can find a cheaper dinner.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Potatoes cost nothing. They're already here. I win.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've got a voucher. Pizza's free.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then best free dinner wins. I'll cook potatoes, you order pizza, and Mum can judge. She always asks for my potatoes.

mechanism: A turns dinner preference and each price objection into a contest whose terms favor A's potatoes.
confusable: Unlike simply arguing for a meal, A must define winning conditions and adjust them to keep an advantage.
comparison: D19-a shifts from peeling to cost to a friendly judge; D19-b shifts from tea strength to speed to refill economy.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
